title: Non-Expanding Gated Continued Fraction Architecture for Feedforward Layers in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work has shown that continued fraction inspired neural architectures (CoFrGeNets) can be highly parameter efficient yet performant for language modeling. In this work, we revisit continued fraction-based channel mixing with the goal of improving its performance and simplifying integration into standard pre-training protocols for language models. We achieve this by two simple yet critical contributions: i) we propose a novel non-expanding gated continued fraction inspired architectural component to replace feedforward layers in established language model architectures that may use vanilla multilayer perceptrons or gated linear units or (vanilla/gated) experts in mixture-of-experts (MoE) type architectures. ii) We propose a way to re-implement divisions -- the non-linearity in these architectures -- in terms of logarithms and exponentials. translated_title: 面向语言模型前馈层的非扩展门控连分数架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.26835v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：最近的研究表明，受连分数启发的神经架构在语言建模中可以做到高度参数高效且性能优异。在本工作中，我们重新审视了基于连分数的通道混合方法，旨在提升其性能，并简化其与语言模型标准预训练协议的集成。我们通过两个简单而关键的贡献来实现这一目标：i) 我们提出了一种新颖的非扩展门控连分数启发的架构组件，用于替换现有语言模型架构中的前馈层，这些架构可以采用普通多层感知机、门控线性单元，或混合专家架构中的（普通/门控）专家。ii) 我们提出了一种用对数和指数重新实现除法运算的方法——除法正是这类架构中的非线性来源。通过在 GPT-2、Llama-3、Mamba- 等不同语言建模架构上进行实验……
tldr: 本文提出一种非扩展门控连分数架构组件，可替换语言模型中的各类前馈层（包括MLP、GLU及MoE专家），并用对数和指数重新实现除法运算，从而提升性能并简化与标准预训练流程的集成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a non-expanding gated continued fraction architecture component to replace feedforward layers in language models (including MLPs, GLUs, and MoE experts), and re-implements divisions using logarithms and exponentials, improving performance while simplifying integration into standard pre-training protocols.
